ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in a grid composed of small squares with side length of 1, points A, B, and C are all on the grid points. If a circle with AB as its diameter passes through points C and D, then what is the value of $\tan\angle ADC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB$ is the diameter,\\
$\therefore\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
In $\triangle ABC$, $\tan\angle ABC= \frac{AC}{BC}=\frac{3}{2}$,\\
Since $\angle ADC=\angle ABC$,\\
$\therefore\tan\angle ADC= \frac{3}{2}$,\\
Therefore $\tan\angle ADC = \boxed{\frac{3}{2}}$.
